description: This Java class 'EngineSnifferStatusPanel' defines a GUI component for displaying real-time engine status information, including time, angle, and RPM, with mouse interaction capabilities to display data at specific points on a waveform or engine cycle.

classes.name: EngineSnifferStatusPanel
classes.description: A GUI component displaying engine cycle status info, updated via mouse movements over a waveform display.

methods.name: EngineSnifferStatusPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the status panel with a zoom provider and setting up GUI labels and layout.

methods.name: mouseMoved
methods.description: Handles mouse movement events to update displayed engine timing and RPM info based on cursor position.

methods.name: setTimeAxisTranslator
methods.description: Setter to update the time-to-position translator used for translating screen coordinates to engine timing.

methods.name: setRevolutions
methods.description: Updates the internal revolution log based on provided revolution data, likely from engine logs.
